name: Windows - Security Analytics - TLS Certificates and Secure Channels
description: Dashboards presenting security analytics on TLS and Schannel events.
title: Windows - Security Analytics - TLS Certificates and Secure Channels

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/windows* "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" ("4868" OR "4869" OR "4870" OR "4871" OR "4872" OR "4873" OR "4875" OR "4876" OR "4877" OR "4878" OR "4879" OR "4880" OR "4881" OR "4882" OR "4883" OR "4884" OR "4885" OR "4886" OR "4887" OR "4888" OR "4889" OR "4890" OR "4891" OR "4892" OR "4893" OR "4894" OR "4895" OR "4896" OR "4897" OR "4898" OR "4899" OR "4900") {{{EventID}}} {{{Computer}}}

| json "Channel", "Provider.Name", "EventID", "Computer" as Channel, Provider, EventID, Computer nodrop
| where Channel = "Security"
| where provider = "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"

| where EventID in ("4868", "4869", "4870", "4871", "4872", "4873", "4875", "4876", "4877", "4878", "4879", "4880", "4881", "4882", "4883", "4884", "4885", "4886", "4887", "4888", "4889", "4890", "4891", "4892", "4893", "4894", "4895", "4896", "4897", "4898", "4899", "4900")

| where EventID matches "{{{EventID}}}"
| where Computer matches "{{{Computer}}}"

| formatDate(_messageTime, "yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss") as date
| count as Events date, EventID, Computer

| "** Unknown **" as Description

| if(EventID="4868", "The certificate manager denied a pending certificate request.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4869", "Certificate Services received a resubmitted certificate request.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4870", "Certificate Services revoked a certificate.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4871", "Certificate Services received a request to publish the certificate revocation list (CRL).", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4872", "Certificate Services published the certificate revocation list (CRL).", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4873", "A certificate request extension changed.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4875", "Certificate Services received a request to shut down.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4876", "Certificate Services backup started.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4877", "Certificate Services backup completed.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4878", "Certificate Services restore started.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4879", "Certificate Services restore completed.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4880", "Certificate Services started.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4881", "Certificate Services stopped.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4882", "The security permissions for Certificate Services changed.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4883", "Certificate Services retrieved an archived key.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4884", "Certificate Services imported a certificate into its database.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4885", "The audit filter for Certificate Services changed..", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4886", "Certificate Services received a certificate request.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4887", "Certificate Services approved a certificate request and issued a certificate.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4888", "Certificate Services denied a certificate request.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4889", "Certificate Services set the status of a certificate request to pending.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4890", "The certificate manager settings for Certificate Services changed.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4891", "A configuration entry changed in Certificate Services.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4892", "A property of Certificate Services changed.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4893", "Certificate Services archived a key.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4894", "Certificate Services imported and archived a key.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4895", "Certificate Services published the CA certificate to Active Directory Domain Services.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4896", "One or more rows have been deleted from the certificate database.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4897", "Role separation enabled.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4898", "Certificate Services loaded a template.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4899", "A Certificate Services template was updated.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="4900", "Certificate Services template security was updated.", Description) as Description

| fields Date, Computer, EventId, Description, Events
| order by Date

_sourceCategory = Labs/windows* "Schannel" ("36864" OR "36866" OR "36867" OR "36868" OR "36869" OR "36870" OR "36871" OR "36872" OR "36873" OR "36874" OR "36875" OR "36876" OR "36877" OR "36878" OR "36879" OR "36880" OR "36881" OR "36882" OR "36883" OR "36884" OR "36885" OR "36886" OR "36887" OR "36888") {{{EventID}}} {{{Computer}}}

| json "Channel", "Provider.Name", "EventID", "Computer" as Channel, Provider, EventID, Computer nodrop
| where Channel = "System"
| where provider = "Schannel"

| where EventID in ("36864", "36866", "36867", "36868", "36869", "36870", "36871", "36872", "36873", "36874", "36875", "36876", "36877", "36878", "36879", "36880", "36881", "36882", "36883", "36884", "36885", "36886", "36887", "36888")
| where EventID matches "{{{EventID}}}"

| where Computer matches "{{{Computer}}}"

| formatDate(_messageTime, "yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss") as date
| count as Events date, EventID, Computer

| "** Unknown **" as Description

| if(EventID="36864", "The Schannel Security Package has Loaded Successfully", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36866", "The Schannel Security Package Has Failed to Load", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36867", "Creating an SSL (client or server) Credential", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36868", "The SSL (client or server) Credential's Private Key Has the Following Properties", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36869", "The SSL (client or server) Credential’s Certificate Does Not Have a Private Key Information Property Attached to it", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36870", "A Fatal Error Occurred When Attempting to Access the SSL (client or server) Credential Private Key", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36871", "A Fatal Error Occurred While Creating An SSL (client or server) Credential", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36872", "No Suitable Default Server Credential Exists on this System", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36873", "No Supported Cipher Suites Were Found When Initiating an SSL Connection", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36874", "An SSL Connection Request Was Received From a Remote Client Application, But None of the Cipher Suites Supported by the Client Application Are Supported by the Server", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36875", "The Remote Server Has Requested SSL Client Authentication, But No Suitable Client Certificate Could Be Found", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36876", "The Certificate Received From the Remote Server Has Not Validated Correctly", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36877", "The Certificate Received From the Remote Client Application Has Not Validated Correctly", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36878", "The Certificate Received From the Remote Client Application Is Not Suitable for Direct Mapping to a Client System Account, Possibly Because the Authority that is Issuing the Certificate Is Not Sufficiently Trusted", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36879", "The Certificate Received From the Remote Client Application Was Not Successfully Mapped to a Client System Account", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36880", "An SSL (client or server) Handshake Completed Successfully", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36881", "The Certificate Received From the Remote Server Has Expired", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36882", "The Certificate Received From the Remote Server Was Issued By an Untrusted Certificate Authority", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36883", "The Certificate Received From the Remote Server Has Been Revoked", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36884", "The Certificate Received From the Remote Server Does Not Contain the Expected Name", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36885", "When Asking for Client Authentication, This Server Sends a List of Trusted Certificate Authorities to the Client.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36886", "No Suitable Default Server Credential Exists on This System", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36887", "A Fatal Alert Was Received", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="36888", "A Fatal Alert Was Generated", Description) as Description

| fields Date, Computer, EventId, Description, Events
| order by Date
